testSuite.details: Full local pytest suite passed twice: 241 passed in 9.86s, then 241 passed in 10.13s.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Scheduler sends Monday, Wednesday, Sunday 18:00, Sunday 22:30, and Sunday 23:00 reminders on the approved Asia/Yekaterinburg schedule.
Reminders go only to active consenting participants without a current-week weekly report.
Reminders skip dropped, non-consenting, and already reported participants.
Sunday 18:00 sends only text and does not start weekly report flow.
One participant send failure does not stop reminder sends to other participants.
A failed reminder recipient gets no more than 3 attempts in one scheduled send.
After retry exhaustion scheduler records failed state in SQLite and sends admin error.
Week close creates gray/⬜ weekly report rows for active participants without final weekly reports.
Active participant without consent receives gray/⬜ at week close if no weekly report exists.
Dropped participant does not receive a new gray/⬜ row through week close.
Participant with unfinished draft receives gray/⬜ at week close and draft remains in SQLite.
Repeated week close does not duplicate weekly reports and writes only missing gray/⬜ rows.
After partial Google Sheets write failure, the next week close continues with missing participants.
After week close participants do not receive a separate gray/⬜ notification.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_scheduler_deadlines.py::test_week_close_sends_aggregated_silent_notification_to_captain_and_tracker verifies only notification bot messages to captain/tracker.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Captain receives one aggregated silent notification for own team.
Tracker receives one aggregated silent notification for assigned team.
Silent notification contains only count and names, without draft state and without other-team data.
Missing captain/tracker chat id does not block week close and sends admin error.
After deadline, finalizing an old draft returns the existing late message and does not change weekly status.
Feature does not generate PDF, team report, group comparison, or production deploy.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Feature diff contains no PDF/report generation/deploy files; git diff name scan found no generated PDF/audio/backup artifacts.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Tech-spec scope excludes PDF/report generation, production deploy, APScheduler/systemd runtime, and live Google/Telegram adapters.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Feature diff limited to local scheduler service, gateway, SQLite repo, messages, tests, and work artifacts.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Scheduler service uses Asia/Yekaterinburg calendar helpers and does not rely on VPS local timezone.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/scheduler/jobs.py uses current_challenge_week_number(); tests/test_scheduler_foundation.py covers timezone immutability.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Sheets access happens through SheetsGateway; scheduler does not call Google APIs directly.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/scheduler/jobs.py depends on SheetsGateway only; no google/gspread imports in scheduler code.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: SQLite stores only technical scheduler/reminder/retry/error state.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/storage/scheduler.py stores job runs, reminder attempts, and error events; tests/test_scheduler_repository.py and tests/test_sqlite_schema.py verify schema behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Final gray weekly report facts are written to Google Sheets gateway, not SQLite only.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: SchedulerService.close_week calls SheetsGateway.append_weekly_report; tests assert rows in FakeSheetsGateway.list_weekly_reports().

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Reminder sends are participant-isolated and retry-capped at 3 attempts.
Week close is idempotent across repeated runs and partial failure recovery.
Silent notifications are team-scoped and role-safe.
Missing recipient chat ids produce admin technical errors without blocking week close.
All new tests and existing local test suite pass.
No secrets, tokens, credentials, live chat ids, or generated files are committed.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: rg scan found only synthetic test strings/docs; git tracked/diff artifact scan found no data/, PDF, SQLite DB, backup, credentials, .env, key, or secrets files.

coverageVerification.notes: No coverage tool threshold is configured for this project; pytest behavior coverage was verified through acceptance mapping and audit reports.

securityAndArtifacts.secretScan: rg scan found no committed live secrets; matches were documentation or synthetic test strings.
securityAndArtifacts.artifactScan: git diff and git ls-files scans found no generated audio, PDF, SQLite DB, backups, credentials, .env, key, or secrets files.
securityAndArtifacts.liveVerification: No live Telegram, live Google Sheets, production deploy, or external service verification was performed.
